svg.title: The sliding window keeps only the last W keys in each row
svg.desc: With W = 4, each query scores only the four most recent keys including itself; earlier keys are masked out of the softmax and never read. The band slides down one row per token, so the work per token is W rather than n. At n = 130,659 and W = 4,096 the windowed path computes 535,179,264 pairs against 8,535,952,470 for full causal attention, 16x fewer.
svg.text: Schematic 10 x 10 grid with W = 4. In the deployment W = 4,096; the band has 4,096 cells per row and
the mask is applied tile by tile.
